summary: Dark product page for an agentic AI suite in 10 blocks: breadcrumb, a head with a video grid, a sticky jump bar, four big stat tiles, a feature slider, a three-column how-it-works, a module tab set with screenshots, a case feature, six FAQs and a closing banner. Needs four projected-outcome figures with a footnote, 3 to 6 features with screenshots, 3 steps, 4 modules, one case and 6 FAQs.

centered heading; four dark rounded tiles with a small label, a huge numeral with percent and a unit line; a small footnote about projected estimates
